# blendops-render-settings

Purpose: Choose Cycles or EEVEE and the output format for stills, sequences, video, or GLB based on the delivery target.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `render-and-output-decisions` | Role `render-engine-and-output-format-decision` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- The user must pick Cycles or EEVEE.
- The output format or file type is undecided.
- Trigger phrases: "Cycles or Eevee", "what render engine", "is Eevee enough", "render is too slow", "PNG or JPEG", "do we need EXR", "what format for the web"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- for a known repeat render (engine already chosen) → use `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`; engine already chosen)
- 3D/GLB exports (out of scope — use blendops-glb-web-handoff, blendops-glb-budget, or blendops-glb-web-handoff) → use `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`; out of scope — use blendops-glb-web-handoff, blendops-glb-budget, or blendops-glb-web-handoff)
- verifying saved files on disk after rendering → use `blendops-final-check` (`references/skill-blendops-final-check.md`; use blendops-final-check)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `deliverable_use_case` (`string`): Whether the output is a final hero still, lookdev preview, animation turntable, or baked GLB source
- Required input `optical_feature_requirements` (`array`): Required optical features (refraction, caustics, Volumetrics, SSS, soft area shadows)
- Required input `render_time_and_hardware_budget` (`string`): Per-frame render time ceiling and available GPU/CPU compute posture
- Optional input `blender_version_token` (`string`): Target Blender version governing BLENDER_EEVEE vs BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT naming
- Optional input `deliverable_channel_and_use` (`string`): Downstream consumer surface (web hero image, compositing EXR pipeline, turntable video, interactive WebGL)
- Optional input `alpha_and_bit_depth_needs` (`object`): Transparency (straight vs premultiplied alpha) and dynamic range (8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit float) requirements
- Optional input `file_size_ceiling` (`string`): Optional delivery file size cap from blendops-glb-budget or web spec
- Output contract: `selected_render_engine_record`, `sample_and_denoiser_targets`, `engine_tradeoff_and_fallback_caveats`, `pinned_container_and_codec_spec`, `bit_depth_and_alpha_mode_record`, `color_space_and_export_verification_hooks` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Confirm the user's goal and the current runtime and artifact state.
2. Pick the branch in the decision tree below.
3. Load only that branch's reference file and follow it.
4. Reply with the user-facing template, keeping truth states honest.

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Lighting and material setup aligned with engine choice → `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "lookdev_planning"]`
- [upstream_reference] Color configuration decision → `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`) — `when.all: [decision.colorLocked equals false]`
- [upstream_reference] Render resolution and aspect ratio decision → `blendops-camera` (`references/skill-blendops-camera.md`) — `when.all: [decision.aspectLocked equals false]`
- [progression] Post-render output verification → `blendops-final-check` (`references/skill-blendops-final-check.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- [progression] 3D / GLB exports (out of scope here) (blendops-glb-web-handoff) → `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.hasAnimation equals true; stage.current equals "animation_handoff"]`
- [boundary_delegation] 3D / GLB exports (out of scope here) (blendops-glb-budget) → `blendops-glb-budget` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-budget.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; budget.pinned equals false]`
- [progression] 3D / GLB exports (out of scope here) (blendops-glb-web-handoff) → `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
